holding_summary: The Commonwealth Court affirmed a zoning hearing board's tie-vote denial of a use variance sought by homeowners to operate a bed-and-breakfast in a large single-family residence in an agricultural/residential district. The court held the tie vote validly maintained the status quo denial as a matter of law and that the record did not compel a finding of unnecessary hardship entitling the owners to the variance.
